name: Mental Health Therapy (B2C)
description: Online therapy, counseling, coaching platforms targeting individuals seeking mental health support

early_stage.definition: MVP or concept, may lack customer testimonials or full credentialing info

checks.message: Tone is becoming too clinical. This vertical needs empathy + authority, not just authority.

checks.rule: CTA text is action-oriented (not 'Learn more', 'See more', 'Explore')
checks.message: CTA should guide action: 'Get matched', 'Check coverage', 'Start assessment'. Vague CTAs reduce conversion.
SUGGEST: Include permission language like 'You deserve...', 'It's okay...' to reduce shame barrier

mid_stage.definition: Beta or soft-launch, have early customers but may lack logos or full metrics

checks.message: Tone is drifting cold. Increase empathy language and warmth for this vertical.
WARN - credentialing is CORE trust signal for therapy. Add therapist qualifications prominently.

checks.rule: at least 1 real testimonial with name, photo, specific outcome
checks.message: MISSING_ASSET - You need real customer stories. Start collecting testimonials from early users.

checks.rule: no countdown timers, scarcity language, or 'limited spots' messaging
checks.message: DESIGN_ISSUE - Pressure tactics backfire for mental health. Remove urgency language.
Layout feels too dense. Add breathing room to signal calm + accessibility.

late_stage.definition: Production ready, full go-to-market, should have testimonials, clear credentialing, full funnel

checks.message: FAIL - Warmth is below expectation for launch. This vertical MUST feel empathetic, not clinical.

checks.rule: therapist qualifications clearly stated (licenses, specialties, experience)
checks.message: FAIL - Credentialing is NON-NEGOTIABLE for therapy. Users must see proof of expertise.

checks.rule: at least 3-5 diverse testimonials with names, photos, specific outcomes
checks.message: FAIL - Need diverse customer stories. Collect more testimonials before launch.

checks.rule: zero countdown timers, scarcity language, pressure tactics
checks.message: FAIL - Pressure tactics detected. Remove all urgency language for production.

checks.rule: clear path from hero CTA → questionnaire → matching process
checks.message: FAIL - Conversion funnel has gaps. Wire all CTAs and clarify the matching process.

checks.rule: explicitly mention 'cancel anytime', flexible scheduling, message at own pace
checks.message: WARN - Flexibility language removes commitment anxiety. Add reassurance: 'cancel anytime', 'message at your pace'

missing_asset_handling.metrics: early_stage=INFO, mid_stage=MISSING if not quantified, late_stage=MISSING if no outcomes
missing_asset_handling.logos: not critical for B2C therapy, don't mark FAIL
missing_asset_handling.notes: Distinguish between 'missing assets' (content not created yet) and 'design issues' (wrong pattern applied)

high_risk: generic_testimonials (no name, photo, or specific outcome)
